description: Easy and Portable: Inflate tires for cars, motorcycles, bikes, balls, and small water sports gear effortlessly. Weighing just 430 grams, it's light and small enough to carry and use anywhere you go. Smart Auto-Stop: Automatically turns off once it reaches the pressure you've set (PSI, BAR, kPa). This helps prevent over-inflation and keeps your equipment safe with accurate inflation every time. Clear Screen & Built-in Light: Comes with a bright digital screen that clearly shows current pressure, your chosen pressure setting, and battery life. A handy LED light helps you see clearly in dark conditions. Energy Efficient and Rechargeable: Automatically turns off when not in use, saving battery life. Recharge easily and quickly using the included USB-C cable, making it convenient to keep powered. Scope of supply: Includes Bosch Easy Pump, USB charging cable, adapters for various equipment (volume adapter, ball needle, Presta valve), and a convenient carry bag—all packed neatly in an eco-friendly box.
